alsoKnownAs.name: Corn flour
alsoKnownAs.note: Nixtamalized corn flour, not raw ground corn.

forms.label: White, dry
forms.sourceNote: Corn flour, masa, unenriched, white. Public domain. No density is stated: the record's own cup portion is a packing figure, air between the grains, and masa harina is whisked into hot liquid rather than poured, so there is nothing here to adopt as a true density.
